synopsis: A hard-working boy named Will enters a magic academy in hopes of becoming a great sorcerer. Unfortunately, there's a fatal flaw in his plan: he lacks the ability to use magic. He just needs to believe in his own unique strengths and remember the promise he made with someone precious to him... (Source: Crunchyroll)
